pre.caption: 审核规则引擎 · 引擎、默认规则注册与三组对照示例（3 / 3，品类绑定版 v0.2）
pre.code:
# ------ 审核引擎 ------
class ReviewEngine: """审核规则引擎"""
def __init__(self): self.rules: List[BaseRule] = [] self.version = "1.0.0"
def register_rule(self, rule: BaseRule): """注册审核规则""" self.rules.append(rule) # 按优先级排序: CRITICAL > MAJOR > MINOR > INFO priority = {Severity.CRITICAL: 0, Severity.MAJOR: 1, Severity.MINOR: 2, Severity.INFO: 3} self.rules.sort(key=lambda r: priority.get(r.severity, 99))
def register_rules(self, rules: List[BaseRule]): for rule in rules: self.register_rule(rule)
def execute_review(self, report_data: Dict, context: Dict = None) -> ReviewResult: """执行完整的审核流程""" import time start_time = time.time()
context = context or {} issues: List[ReviewIssue] = []
# 品类解析：绑定表决定启用与参数；未配置品类只跑通用集并给出可见提示 category = (report_data.get("sample_info") or {}).get("category_code", "") context["category"] = category context.setdefault("bindings", {}) if category and not context["bindings"]: issues.append(ReviewIssue( rule_id="CAT-UNCAT-01", rule_name="品类未配置规则绑定", category=RuleCategory.DATA_COMPLETENESS, severity=Severity.INFO, status=ReviewStatus.WARNING, message=f"品类 {category} 未配置专属规则，本次仅执行通用集 28 条", location="品类绑定", suggestion="在规则台账为该品类补 17 行品类专属绑定")) context["universal_only"] = True else: context["overrides"] = {rid: b.get("overrides", {}) for rid, b in context["bindings"].items()} passed = 0 failed = 0 warnings = 0 skipped = 0
for rule in self.rules: # 检查规则是否适用 if not rule.is_applicable(context): skipped += 1 continue
try: issue = rule.execute(report_data, context) issues.append(issue)
if issue.status == ReviewStatus.PASS: passed += 1 elif issue.status == ReviewStatus.FAIL: failed += 1 elif issue.status == ReviewStatus.WARNING: warnings += 1 elif issue.status == ReviewStatus.SKIP: skipped += 1
except Exception as e: # 规则执行异常,记录但不阻断 issues.append(ReviewIssue( rule_id=rule.rule_id, rule_name=rule.rule_name, category=rule.category, severity=Severity.INFO, status=ReviewStatus.WARNING, message=f"规则执行异常: {str(e)}", location="系统", suggestion="请联系系统管理员" )) warnings += 1
# 计算总体结果 executed = passed + failed + warnings critical_count = sum(1 for i in issues if i.status == ReviewStatus.FAIL and i.severity == Severity.CRITICAL) major_count = sum(1 for i in issues if i.status == ReviewStatus.FAIL and i.severity == Severity.MAJOR) minor_count = sum(1 for i in issues if i.status == ReviewStatus.FAIL and i.severity == Severity.MINOR)
# 总体状态判定 if critical_count > 0: overall_status = ReviewStatus.FAIL elif major_count > 0 or warnings > 0: overall_status = ReviewStatus.WARNING else: overall_status = ReviewStatus.PASS
# 评分计算 (100分制) score = 100.0 score -= critical_count * 20 # 每个严重问题扣20分 score -= major_count * 10 # 每个一般问题扣10分 score -= minor_count * 3 # 每个轻微问题扣3分 score = max(0, score)
elapsed_ms = int((time.time() - start_time) * 1000)
return ReviewResult( report_id=report_data.get("report_id", "unknown"), review_time=datetime.now(), total_rules_executed=executed, total_rules_passed=passed, total_rules_failed=failed, total_rules_warning=warnings, overall_status=overall_status, overall_score=score, issues=[i for i in issues if i.status != ReviewStatus.PASS], # 只返回有问题的 critical_count=critical_count, major_count=major_count, minor_count=minor_count, review_duration_ms=elapsed_ms, engine_version=self.version )
# ------ 引擎初始化与使用示例 ------
def create_default_engine() -> ReviewEngine: """创建默认规则引擎(含所有标准规则)""" engine = ReviewEngine() engine.register_rules([ SampleInfoCompletenessRule(), DateLogicRule(), ParallelSampleDeviationRule(universal=False), # A03-2 属品类专属，见 3.9 SignificantFiguresRule(), StandardLimitCheckRule(), # ... 更多规则 ]) return engine
# 使用示例（示例领域：电网物资——高强度螺栓连接副抽检） if __name__ == "__main__": engine = create_default_engine()
# 模拟报告数据：输电线路铁塔用钢结构高强度螺栓连接副 10.9级 M20 report_data = { "report_id": "DQ-2026-00871", "sample_info": { "sample_id": "S-2026-00871", "sample_name": "钢结构用高强度大六角头螺栓连接副 10.9级 M20", "client_name": "XX电力物资有限公司", "receive_date": "2026-10-28", "sampling_date": "2026-10-27", "test_date": "2026-10-30", "report_date": "2026-11-02", "sample_status": "正常，封样完好", "category_code": "CAT-BOLT", "test_standard": "GB/T 1231-2010", }, "test_results": [ {"parameter": "抗拉强度", "value": 1043.6, "unit": "MPa", "judgment": "合格", "significant_figures": 4}, {"parameter": "扭矩系数", "value": 0.131, "judgment": "合格", "significant_figures": 3}, {"parameter": "硬度", "value": 35.2, "unit": "HRC", "judgment": "合格", "significant_figures": 3}, ], "qc_data": { "parallel_samples": [ # 同一批连接副取两组做扭矩系数平行测定 {"parameter": "扭矩系数", "value1": 0.102, "value2": 0.152, "max_deviation": 10}, ] } }
context = { "domain": "grid_material", "standard_limits": { # 10.9 级：GB/T 3098.1 规定 Rm >= 1000 MPa，硬度 HRC 32~39 "抗拉强度": {"type": "min", "min_value": 1000}, "硬度": {"type": "range", "min_value": 32.0, "max_value": 39.0}, # GB/T 1231 规定扭矩系数平均值 0.110~0.150 "扭矩系数": {"type": "range", "min_value": 0.110, "max_value": 0.150}, }, "requires_parallel": True, # 品类绑定（来自 ai_review_category_bindings，见 3.9） "bindings": { "A03-2": {"enabled": True, "overrides": {"parallel_count": 8, "max_deviation": 10}}, "A01": {"enabled": True, "overrides": {}}, "B01": {"enabled": True, "overrides": {}}, "C01-1": {"enabled": True, "overrides": {}}, "D01": {"enabled": True, "overrides": {}}, }, }
result = engine.execute_review(report_data, context) print(result.summary) for issue in result.issues: print(f" [{issue.severity.value}] {issue.rule_name}: {issue.message}") # 对照一：未配置绑定的品类（如电缆保护管）只跑通用集，并给出可见提示 ctx_unbound = dict(context); ctx_unbound["bindings"] = {} r2 = engine.execute_review(report_data, ctx_unbound) print("\n[未配置品类对照] " + r2.summary) for issue in r2.issues: print(f" [{issue.severity.value}] {issue.rule_name}: {issue.message}")
# 对照二：绝缘手套逐只试验，A03-2 由绑定显式停用 ctx_glove = dict(context) ctx_glove["bindings"] = {"A03-2": {"enabled": False}, "B01-3": {"enabled": True, "overrides": {"cycle_months": 6}}} r3 = engine.execute_review(report_data, ctx_glove) print("\n[绝缘手套对照] " + r3.summary + " # A03-2 被绑定停用，故只执行 4 条")
